title: stage-back run in a worker's own worktree looks for the worktree nested inside itself
goal: backlog.py stage-back ID (and --check) run with the worker's worktree as root finds that worktree and the scratch directory of the checkout that dispatched it, so the worker runs it as its brief says without a --root naming the orchestrator's checkout. Found by the SP-4cc36epy close: the workers of BG-jy6yxnq4, BG-ljlj77kd and BG-6jwv6ag3 each had to rerun it with --root set to the orchestrator's checkout.

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P
T=os.path.abspath('_tools/backlog.py');r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());g=lambda *a,c=r:s.run(['git','-C',str(c),'-c','user.name=x','-c','user.email=x@x',*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
g('init','-q');d=r/'kb'/'_self'/'backlog';d.mkdir(parents=True);(r/'backlog.json').write_text(json.dumps({'item_dir':'kb/_self/backlog'}))
(r/'.gitignore').write_text('_cache/\n.claude/worktrees/\n')
(d/'ST-aaaaaaaa.json').write_text(json.dumps({'id':'ST-aaaaaaaa','kind':'story','title':'t','status':'doing','priority':'P3','goal':'g','touches':['x.txt'],'checks':[{'run':['python3','-c','print(1)']}]},indent=2)+'\n')
(r/'x.txt').write_text('x\n');g('add','-A');g('commit','-qm','i')
w=r/'.claude'/'worktrees'/'agent-ST-aaaaaaaa';g('worktree','add','-q','-b','work/ST-aaaaaaaa',str(w))
(r/'_cache'/'scratch'/'ST-aaaaaaaa'/'staging').mkdir(parents=True)
env=dict(os.environ);env.pop('KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG',None)
p=s.run([sys.executable,T,'--root',str(w),'stage-back','ST-aaaaaaaa','--check'],cwd=str(w),capture_output=True,text=True,env=env)
o=(p.stdout+p.stderr).strip();print('exit',p.returncode,o[-300:]);sys.exit(1 if 'has no worktree' in o else 0)
